method: Independent NumPy/stdlib rescore from CARD and raw instances

numeric_tolerance.purpose: comparison of floating-point reductions only; eligibility/counts/flags are exact

comparison.json_projection: Join M0 H1-H3 and P H4 on regime/tau; pass flags are ungated predicates, eligible flags are separate
comparison.specification_limit: CARD section 3 does not define GM or Gamma. The independent first computation declared Gamma=L00-L10-L01+L11. The reference uses the opposite sign on these data. This is a convention mismatch, not evidence of a faulty scorer; no post-reference sign flip is applied.
